isolation.reason: Actual chroot, privilege-drop, seccomp, gold exclusion, readonly-runtime and UID cleanup probe passed

declared_components: Full writable task root including workspace/.git/index, ignored/untracked files, tmp, wheels and venv; chroot immutable runtime is separately identified and not copied per snapshot
File bytes, modes, owners, mtime, symlinks and internal hardlink relationships
Exact model-visible token prefix, context tool/LLM counters, submitted patch and logical budgets
Same-path task bindings, official tool/executor source hashes, Python and installed package identity including external task profiles referenced by venv .pth files
No surviving child task processes: bwrap PID namespace termination or chroot unique-UID kill and quiescence verification
Host asset/output/code visibility excluded by actual bwrap masks or by an allowlisted chroot runtime plus capability/UID/seccomp restrictions
unrestorable_components: Host absolute clock, kernel entropy, scheduling and external read-only files not covered by runtime bindings
Filesystem inode numbers, ctime and atime; copied file bytes/modes/mtime are restored
state.external_runtime_boundary: The host runtime is mounted read-only to task commands. Package versions/RECORD hashes identify dependencies; they are not a byte-for-byte snapshot of the entire host filesystem. The collector must not mutate host dependencies during this experiment.
state.caller_contract: Collector serializes model/tool requests; capture occurs with no in-flight model or tool request. Branch seeds are intervention metadata. Clock/entropy-sensitive tasks are outside complete declared scope.
